title: host add records a compute-only OpenSSH on a non-22 port by USER@HOST:PORT and by ssh-config alias, and refuses a port that opens a plain shell
description: The host is a fixture on 127.0.0.1 whose port 22 is Tailscale SSH (any account gets a plain shell), prepared by running the script `graphyard host prepare` prints, which adds an OpenSSH for gy-compute only on port 2222 with the forced-command graphyard-host-shim. `host add gy-compute@127.0.0.1:2222` and `host add local-compute` (an ssh-config alias for that port) record the host; `host add gy-compute@127.0.0.1:22` is refused because a plain shell opens there.

steps.name: host add by port and by alias records the compute-only port; the plain-shell port is refused
